title: źle obliczany IOB
symptom: The IOB value on the main screen does not update after boluses; it only updates after refreshing the pump history. Also, AAPS delivered 22 units of insulin despite IOBmax being set to 15 units.
cause: The problem was with the Medtronic driver.
fix: The problem was resolved after an update by @andyrozman to issue #4664.
evidence_quote: The problem was with the Medtronic driver. After an update by @andyrozman to issue number #4664, the problem was resolved.
